name: Empiric CARBOplatin + PACLitaxel (unfavorable cancer of unknown primary)
histology: adenocarcinoma or carcinoma not otherwise specified, not site specific (unfavorable CUP)

biomarkers.note: PRIORITY CAVEAT: This is EMPIRIC chemotherapy for unfavorable adenocarcinoma/carcinoma CUP that is NOT site specific. IHC/ISH and molecular (NGS) profiling to identify a tissue of origin or an actionable biomarker takes priority: site-specific therapy for a favorable/identified primary, and biomarker-driven therapy (BRAF V600E dabrafenib/trametinib; dMMR/MSI-H or TMB-high pembrolizumab/dostarlimab; NTRK-fusion entrectinib/larotrectinib/repotrectinib; RET-fusion selpercatinib; HER2 IHC 3+ fam-trastuzumab deruxtecan) should be used when applicable. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Occult Primary (CUP) v2.2026, Principles of Systemic Therapy (Adenocarcinoma) and the Biomarker-Driven Therapy column.

lineOfTherapy: first-line empiric chemotherapy for unfavorable adenocarcinoma/carcinoma CUP (not site specific) when no favorable subset, directable primary, or actionable biomarker is identified

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: IHC/ISH and molecular (NGS) profiling completed; no favorable subset, tissue of origin, or actionable biomarker directing site-specific or biomarker-driven therapy
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v2.2026 (05/04/26), OCC Principles of Systemic Therapy (Adenocarcinoma, lines 1332 to 1358); tissue of origin studies and biomarker testing (lines 309 to 310, footnote g line 148)

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: adenocarcinoma or carcinoma not otherwise specified, not site specific
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v2.2026, Selected Systemic Therapy for Occult Primaries: Adenocarcinoma, Preferred: Carboplatin/Paclitaxel (line 1336)

drugs.name: CARBOplatin

provenance.locator: OCC Principles of Systemic Therapy, Carboplatin/Paclitaxel dosing, line 1397 (Carboplatin AUC 5 to 6 IV Day 1; repeat every 3 weeks)

drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v2.2026, line 1397. CARBOplatin target AUC 5 to 6 IV on day 1, repeat every 3 weeks (printed range retained). Source-stated weekly alternative (line 1401): CARBOplatin AUC 2 IV on days 1, 8, and 15, repeat every 4 weeks. Tall-man per ISMP.

drugs.name: PACLitaxel

provenance.locator: OCC Principles of Systemic Therapy, Carboplatin/Paclitaxel dosing, line 1398 (Paclitaxel 175 to 200 mg/m2 IV Day 1; repeat every 3 weeks)

drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v2.2026, line 1398. PACLitaxel 175 to 200 mg/m2 IV on day 1, repeat every 3 weeks (printed range retained). Requires corticosteroid plus H1 and H2 antihistamine premedication per labeling. Source-stated weekly alternative (line 1402): PACLitaxel 80 mg/m2 IV on days 1, 8, and 15, repeat every 4 weeks. Tall-man per ISMP.

premedications.name: PACLitaxel premedication
premedications.notes: corticosteroid plus H1 and H2 antihistamine per paclitaxel labeling.

supportiveCare: Antiemetics: carboplatin/paclitaxel is moderate emetic risk; prophylaxis per moderate-emetogenicity tier.
Renal function monitoring - CARBOplatin (AUC-based dosing via Calvert formula).

monitoring: renal function (creatinine/GFR) for AUC dosing - CARBOplatin
response assessment; re-evaluate for a directable primary or actionable biomarker if profiling was incomplete

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 3 to 4 neutropenia or significant neuropathy
doseModificationRules.text: Hold or reduce per labeling for grade 3 to 4 myelosuppression or significant peripheral neuropathy; clinical review required.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: DeVita establishes empiric platinum/taxane chemotherapy for unfavorable CUP and the primacy of tissue-of-origin/biomarker-directed therapy for favorable and molecularly defined subsets; the per-cycle carboplatin/paclitaxel doses are taken from the guideline layer.

guideline.locator: Principles of Systemic Therapy, Selected Systemic Therapy for Occult Primaries: Adenocarcinoma, Preferred: Carboplatin/Paclitaxel (line 1336); dosing lines 1396 to 1403 (Carboplatin AUC 5 to 6 + Paclitaxel 175 to 200 mg/m2, day 1, every 3 weeks; weekly alternative Carboplatin AUC 2 + Paclitaxel 80 mg/m2 days 1, 8, 15 every 4 weeks). Biomarker-driven therapy priority (BRAF/dMMR-MSI-H/NTRK/RET/TMB-H/HER2) lines 1336 to 1358; molecular profiling footnote g line 148; tissue of origin studies line 310.

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for empiric CARBOplatin + PACLitaxel in unfavorable cancer of unknown primary (adenocarcinoma/carcinoma, not site specific). Every dose is grounded in Standard Guidelines (NCCN) Occult Primary (CUP) v2.2026, OCC Principles of Systemic Therapy: CARBOplatin target AUC 5 to 6 IV day 1 (line 1397) and PACLitaxel 175 to 200 mg/m2 IV day 1 (line 1398), repeat every 3 weeks; the printed dose ranges are retained as authored. A source-stated weekly alternative (carboplatin AUC 2 plus paclitaxel 80 mg/m2 on days 1, 8, 15 every 4 weeks, lines 1401 to 1402) is recorded in the drug notes. IMPORTANT: this is empiric therapy for the not-site-specific unfavorable subset; IHC/ISH and molecular (NGS) profiling to identify a tissue of origin or actionable biomarker takes priority, and site-specific or biomarker-driven therapy (BRAF, dMMR/MSI-H, TMB-H, NTRK, RET, HER2) should be used when applicable (lines 1336 to 1358) - this is stated in biomarkers.note, eligibility, and monitoring. ISMP tall-man applied (CARBOplatin, PACLitaxel); paclitaxel corticosteroid/antihistamine premedication enforced. No field is set to VERIFY. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
